exposure: delivery in a baby-friendly certified hospital (BFH)
cohort: The study included 1214 mothers of legal age from Austria, who received four online questionnaires during their child's first year of life.
finding: Higher monthly household net income, delivery in a baby-friendly certified hospital, and breastfeeding support were associated with a longer exclusive breastfeeding duration, while obese mothers had a higher risk of early weaning and starting infant formula earlier.
mod_finding: Delivery in a baby-friendly certified hospital (BFH) was associated with a longer exclusive breastfeeding duration.
